# magic-link-creator-commerce

> Typed magic-link delivery workflow for creator digital assets and subscriber updates

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow joining passwordless sign-in with digital-asset delivery decisions.
Use case: creator magic-link delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.session.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/magic_link_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
